anomalies.description: Duplex Penthouse 6202-6302 Double Entry in Inventory Schedule: The duplex penthouse spanning floors 62 and 63 is entered twice in the statutory disclosure: once at Sr 185 with its full carpet area of 372.66 sq.m, and again at Sr 186 as an upper-level reference with #N/A area.
anomalies.significance: Clarifies that while the row count of the inventory schedule is 186, the physical count of unique residential dwelling units in Wing A is 185.

anomalies.description: Multi-Developer Heritage (DB Realty to Rustomjee / Keystone Realtors): Project was originally initiated by DB Realty under Bhishma Realty Ltd as 'DB Crown' and subsequently transitioned to Real Gem Buildtech Pvt. Ltd. under the Rustomjee Group ('Rustomjee Crown').
documents_involved: FORM 4 Architect Certificate Wing A and B.pdf
anomalies.significance: Explains why older municipal records reference DB Realty / DB Crown while current RERA filings and Occupancy Certificates are branded Rustomjee Crown.

anomalies.description: Independent CA Certification Talley Confirmation: The disclosure document explicitly certifies that the unit inventory has been tallied and confirmed against Annexure 'A' of Form 3 issued by the Chartered Accountant, satisfying documentary block independent area verification.
anomalies.significance: Provides robust third-party verification for SC5 independent area source compliance.

anomalies.description: Multi-Source Extraction vs. Layout OCR Model Synthesis: Synthesis of 34-document statutory portfolio data (186 RERA units, Part 1 & 2 OCCs, Form 4 Architect Certificate) with direct layout CAD OCR model findings on 17_page_1 and Crown Layout Approval_page_2.
documents_involved: FORM 4 Architect Certificate Wing A and B.pdf
anomalies.significance: Preserved 100% of OCR verbatim strings and layout source citations while maintaining full statutory unit and approval integrity.

something_new.description: Massive Integrated Podium-Top Paved Recreational Ground (RG): Master layout plan (Crown Layout Approval.pdf) incorporates a massive 8,654.89 sq.m paved recreational ground (RG-1) on top of the 10th podium level, providing a continuous elevated landscape connecting Wing A, Wing B, and Wing C.

Public Parking Lot (PPL) Substructure Multi-Tier Integration: Integrated municipal Public Parking Lot spans 5 levels: 1st to 3rd Basements + Ground + 1st & 2nd Podiums, granted Full OCC under EB/5070/GS/A/OCC/1/New dated 08 August 2023.

100% Construction Completion Fully Certified across All 63 Floors: Unlike under-construction filings, Rustomjee Crown Wing A has achieved 100% physical completion, validated by sequential Part OCCs (Parts 1, 2, 3) culminating in Form 4 Architect Completion Certificate dated 31 January 2025.
